correctness.rationale: Explicit order-homotopy reductions prove each nonempty intersection of target-adjoin subcomplexes contractible. The nerve equals the m-consecutive cyclic-interval complex by both implications. The good circle arc cover shares the nerve with contractible intersections. Natural equivariant nerve equivalences and free cyclic rotations give homotopy, integral homology and quotient degree. n=3 excluded, n>=5 verified. Exact finite checks check n=5,7,9,11.
